name: TimeCard
description: Organization-scoped staff time-card record. A card captures a submitted immutable snapshot of one employee's TimeEntry records for one payroll period and supports manager return, approval, and archive review.

org_id.description: Canonical Organization.id scope. Required for every Time Card.

employee_id.description: User.id of the staff member who owns this Time Card.

period_start.description: Inclusive first date of the payroll period.

period_end.description: Inclusive last date of the payroll period.

period_key.description: Deterministic payroll-period identifier generated server-side from period_start and period_end.

status.description: submitted locks included entries from staff edits; returned reopens them for correction; approved is final and belongs in the archive.

entry_ids.description: TimeEntry IDs included in this submitted Time Card. Used for server-side lock enforcement.

entry_snapshot.description: Immutable server-generated snapshot of all included entries as they existed at the most recent submission.

total_minutes.description: Server-calculated sum of duration_minutes for all entries in entry_ids.

submission_revision.description: Starts at 1 and increments whenever a returned card is resubmitted.

last_submitted_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent submission or resubmission.

submitted_by_user_id.description: User.id that submitted or most recently resubmitted this card.

returned_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent manager return-for-correction action.

returned_by_user_id.description: Manager User.id that most recently returned this card.

return_note.description: Manager explanation of corrections required before resubmission.

approved_by_user_id.description: Manager User.id that approved this card.

archived_at.description: Set server-side at approval. Approved cards remain viewable through the Time Card archive.
